scenarios.name: healthy_minimum_ventilation
scenarios.description: OAF 0.15 exactly on design (oat 2 °C, rat 22 °C, mat 19 °C), occupied with the fan running — the deficit is zero and the rule is silent

scenarios.name: damper_shut_no_outdoor_air
scenarios.description: The failure this rule exists for: OA damper shut, so mat tracks rat (22 °C) and the inferred fraction is 0 against a 0.15 design. Deficit 0.15 > 0.05 and the rule alarms after alarm_delay. AHU-FC-006 runs the same quotient with a symmetric 0.30 band, whose low side sits below a fraction of −0.15, and reads this same unit as healthy

scenarios.name: unoccupied_deficit_stays_clear
scenarios.description: Same shut damper, unoccupied: the reference scopes under-ventilation to occupied hours because there is nobody to under-ventilate, and the occ_schedule conjunct holds yFault down

scenarios.name: fan_off_deficit_stays_clear
scenarios.description: Same shut damper, occupied, fan off: with no airflow the mixing box delivers nothing to infer a fraction from, and sf_status holds yFault down

scenarios.name: negative_fraction_alarms
scenarios.description: mat 23 °C sits above both rat (22 °C) and oat (2 °C), so the inferred fraction is −0.05 and the deficit reads 0.20. The rule alarms: with honest sensors that is a shut damper plus duct conduction, and with a lying mat it is the reading AHU-FC-062 suppression exists to silence

scenarios.name: deficit_exactly_at_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case: OAF 0.10 exactly (oat 2 °C, rat 22 °C, mat 20 °C), so the deficit equals oa_deficit_margin — the strict `>` means no fault

scenarios.name: deficit_just_over_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case, other side: OAF 0.09 (mat 20.2 °C) puts the deficit at 0.06 and the rule alarms after alarm_delay

scenarios.name: small_delta_not_evaluable
scenarios.description: NO_EVAL with the gate doing work: |oat − rat| = 2 °C (oat 20 °C, rat 22 °C) and mat 21.9 °C, so the fraction reads 0.05 and deficitBig is true — an ungated rule would alarm on a mixture the two sources cannot locate; yTempDeltaOk stays false and holds yFault down

scenarios.name: delta_exactly_at_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case: |oat − rat| = 6.0 °C exactly (oat 16 °C, rat 22 °C) with the damper shut (mat 22 °C) — the strict `>` leaves the rule not evaluable, so a full ventilation deficit still reports NO_EVAL rather than healthy

scenarios.name: delta_just_over_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case, other side: |oat − rat| = 6.5 °C (oat 15.5 °C, rat 22 °C) with the same shut damper — evaluable, and the deficit alarms after alarm_delay

scenarios.name: transient_deficit_clears_before_delay
scenarios.description: Transient: the damper drops to shut at t=600 and returns to minimum at t=1500 — 900 s of deficit, short of alarm_delay, so a damper stroke or a purge cycle never becomes an alarm

scenarios.name: occupancy_start_restarts_persistence
scenarios.description: The deficit is present from t=0 but the building is unoccupied until t=1200, so the 30-minute clock starts at occupancy rather than at the deficit — the alarm lands at 3000 s, not 1800 s

scenarios.name: recovery_clears_alarm
scenarios.description: Recovery: the shut damper alarms after alarm_delay, then reopens to design minimum at t=3000 (OAF 0.15) — yFault drops on that tick, with no hold-off
